theorems.name: Submission.cbrldvc_setIntegral_le_sub_of_subset
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (V W : Set (Euclid P)), AEStronglyMeasurable g μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, |g x| ≤ 1) → MeasurableSet V → V ⊆ W → μ W < ∞ → ∫ y in V, g y ∂μ ≤ θ * (μ V).toReal → ∫ y in W, g y ∂μ ≤ (μ W).toReal - (1 - θ) * (μ V).toReal
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
